name: 活动策划方案
description: 从一个活动想法写出能执行的策划方案：活动简报（SMART 目标和衡量指标）→ 流程表、预算和风险预案（并行）→ 完整方案 → 检查流程时间、预算算术和预备金、风险覆盖，以及 1000 人以上公开活动的安全许可。 / Turn an event idea into a plan people can run: a brief with SMART objectives and measures → run of show, budget and risk register (in parallel) → the full proposal → checks on timing, budget arithmetic and contingency, risk coverage, and the safety permit for public events of 1,000 or more.

event.description: 活动是什么，例如：社区咖啡馆周年庆市集 / What the event is, e.g. a neighborhood café's anniversary market

goal.description: 办这个活动想达到什么，例如：带来新会员 / What the event is for, e.g. new members

audience.description: invite 邀请制，public 面向社会公众（影响是否需要公安安全许可）/ invite-only, or open to the public (decides whether a public-security permit applies)

budget.description: 总预算（含预备金）/ Total budget, contingency included

venue.description: 场地，例如：商场中庭、户外草坪 / The venue, e.g. a mall atrium or an outdoor lawn

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English / Output language: zh or en

stages.name: 活动简报
stages.description: 目的、2 到 4 个 SMART 目标（每个带衡量指标和数值）、目标人群、核心信息、形式、时间和场地。 / The purpose, 2 to 4 SMART objectives (each with a measure and a number), the audience, the key message, the format, the date and the venue.

stages.name: 流程表
stages.description: 从搭建到撤场按分钟排：开始时间、时长、内容、负责人和出状况时的备选。 / Minute by minute from setup to teardown: start, length, item, owner and a fallback.

stages.name: 预算
stages.description: 按类别列出每一项的数量、单价和小计，再留 10% 到 15% 的预备金。 / Every line by category with quantity, unit price and subtotal, plus a 10% to 15% contingency.

stages.name: 风险预案
stages.description: 人流、消防和安全、天气、设备和供电、医疗、延误、供应商等风险，每条有可能性、影响、预防措施、发生后怎么办和负责人。 / Crowd, fire and safety, weather, equipment and power, medical, delays, suppliers and more, each with likelihood, impact, prevention, response and an owner.

stages.name: 策划方案
stages.description: 把简报、流程、预算和风险写成一份给老板或客户审批的方案，最后写效果怎么衡量和复盘。 / Combine the brief, run of show, budget and risks into one proposal for sign-off, ending with how success is measured and reviewed.

stages.name: 检查
stages.description: 检查目标能不能衡量、流程时间接不接得上、每项有没有负责人、预算乘法和总额、预备金比例、风险有没有漏掉的类别，以及要不要申请大型群众性活动安全许可。 / Checks that objectives are measurable, the run of show adds up with an owner for every item, the budget arithmetic and total, the contingency share, missing risk categories, and whether a large-event safety permit is needed.
